libwebp 1.5.0 -- the DECODER only

Source:   https://github.com/webmproject/libwebp , tag v1.5.0, the archive
          https://github.com/webmproject/libwebp/archive/refs/tags/v1.5.0.tar.gz
          (3,821,241 bytes), downloaded 2026-11-03 with the author's yes (IM9b).

WHAT IS HERE (89 files, 1.3 MB): src/dec, src/dsp and src/utils minus the encoder's .c files, the public headers the
decoder includes (src/webp/decode.h, types.h, format_constants.h, and encode.h and mux_types.h, which utils.c,
palette.c and webp_dec.c include for type names), and the five src/enc HEADERS that dsp/lossless.h includes
(prototypes only: no encoder .c file is built), with COPYING, PATENTS and AUTHORS.
  NOT vendored: any src/enc .c, src/mux, src/demux, sharpyuv, the encoder's dsp files (cost*, enc*, lossless_enc*,
  ssim*), the encoder's utils (bit_writer, huffman_encode, quant_levels), and the mips / msa variants (no such target).
  Not one file is edited. There is no config header: threads are off (WEBP_USE_THREAD undefined), and each SIMD
  variant (SSE2, SSE4.1, NEON) is chosen by the compiler's target macros and, at run time, by libwebp's CPU probe.
  Built by build.zig addWebp into stz_image only (needs_webp), without the UB sanitizer (its bit readers shift by
  design), and called from image.zig through decode.h (WebPGetFeatures, WebPDecodeRGB, WebPDecodeRGBA).

WHAT IT DOES NOT READ, said so a reader is not surprised: animated WebP (its frames need the demux library) is
refused by name; the engine writes no WebP.

The archive's sha256 below is the one COMPUTED on download: GitHub publishes no hash for a tag archive, so it cannot
be compared with an upstream value, and the tree below is the checked-in subset, not the archive.
